trailhead.name: Devils Postpile Trailhead (Fern Lake Trail, overnight lot)

otherFacts.value: Fern Lake, Anona Lake, Corral Meadow

notes: Strengthened over first pass: a trip report for Iron Mountain itself uses the Fern Lake trail from Devils Postpile.
